title: Y-linked inheritance family
goal: Show father-to-son-only inheritance across three generations.

rubric.must: The pedigree visibly shows an affected male founder.
The drawing visibly shows affected fathers with affected sons in two generations.
The proband III-1 is marked with an arrow that stops just outside the lower-left edge of the symbol and is labelled P.
Roman generation labels and individual identifiers are visibly ordered across generations.
Standard pedigree sex and affected/carrier symbol fills are visibly distinguishable.
Partnership and parent-child lines make biological relationships unambiguous.

ideal.notes: Every son of an affected father is solid-filled and every daughter is empty across three generations, with proband III-1 in generation III.
